title: On a carrier lying a.e. inside a C¹ submanifold, the approximate tangent planes are the submanifold's tangent planes
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every integer multiplicity triple R = (S, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n and all M, V ⊆ ℝ^P, assume three things: M is an embedded C¹ n-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M); V is open; and Hⁿ((S ∩ V) ∖ M) = 0, where Hⁿ := μHE[n]. Then approxTangentPlane n S x = span(tangentSpace M x) for Hⁿ⌞(S ∩ V)-a.e. x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (M V : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 n M → IsOpen V → μHE[n] ((R.carrier ∩ V) \ M) = 0 → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ V)), approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x = Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)
